title: parse.rs extract_headers: String::from_utf8_lossy().trim().to_owned() — triple allocation
description: parse.rs extract_headers line 89: .map(|bytes| String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).trim().to_owned()). from_utf8_lossy may allocate a Cow::Owned if there are replacement chars. .trim() borrows that string. .to_owned() then allocates again. For messages with many headers (50+) this is 2-3 allocations per header. .trim_ascii() on the raw bytes before conversion, or building the owned String directly from a slice-and-trim, avoids the intermediate Cow.
